blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Written from Muse's known Tsawwassen East research (sources (as of November 1, 2026)) and the City of Delta's development page, which I read myself. Items marked unconfirmed could not be checked against an official page.
A board name, not a City of Delta neighbourhood

Tsawwassen East is the name the MLS® board uses for the Boundary Bay side of Tsawwassen, east of 56 Street. It is not an official City of Delta neighbourhood, and the City publishes no boundary for it. That matters when you read a Delta report or a plan, because the City talks about Tsawwassen as a whole and uses its own planning names.

Next to it, Tsawwassen Central sits to the west, Boundary Bay and Point Roberts, in the United States, lie to the south, and Ladner is to the north. Beach Grove, the waterfront pocket on Boundary Bay, is the part of the east side most people mean when they say beachfront. Search names that point to the same area include Boundary Bay and South Delta.
The Boundary Bay shore

Boundary Bay Regional Park and Centennial Beach are at 570 Boundary Bay Road. Metro Vancouver, which runs the park, lists the Dyke Trail, the Savannah and Raptor trails and Cammidge House there. For most east-side buyers the beach and the dyke are the reason to be here, and they are also the reason to read the shoreline rules below before you fall for a house.
Shoreline and flood rules, one at a time

These rules come from three places: the City's own development page, Delta's Official Community Plan and its Zoning Bylaw. They are easy to confuse, so each gets its own row. The City says exact flood figures for a lot are on DeltaMap or from its Community Planning and Development department, so treat the table as a map of what to ask, not a substitute for the lot check.

Development along the Boundary Bay shorefront needs an engineered seawall designed by a professional structural engineer.
City of Delta, development considerations page
Changes to a dike or the ground next to it need prior written approval from the Inspector of Dikes. A right-of-way for future dike work may be required.
City of Delta, development considerations page

Delta's 2024 OCP has a hazard development permit area for the Boundary Bay foreshore and the Southlands. It sets a habitable floor at no lower than 2.9 metres on the Geodetic Survey of Canada datum, land around the building at 2.3 metres at least, and no building within 7.5 metres of the natural boundary of a tidal area. Whether a given lot is inside SD3 has to be checked for that lot.

Zoning Bylaw 7600, section 6.2.3, covers lots fronting Boundary Bay along Beach Grove Road south of 16 Avenue. A seawall may extend into the minimum front setback. The bylaw states no flood construction level for Beach Grove.
Land within 30 metres of a stream, river, slough, ditch or pond is in the streamside permit area. This is about watercourses, not the sea or the dike.
City of Delta, development considerations page

blocks.text: The SD3 figures are the ones to double check before you rely on them. If you are buying on the water, ask the City which of these rules apply to the exact parcel, and ask your insurer for a quote before you remove subjects.
Who looks after the dike, and who owns the foreshore

The City of Delta is the diking authority. It operates and maintains more than 63 kilometres of flood protection works, 31 drainage pump stations and about 538 kilometres of drainage works across the municipality, and the east side of Tsawwassen faces Boundary Bay behind the Boundary Bay dike.

The foreshore is a different story. The Province owns nearly all saltwater foreshore, so a dock or private moorage is not part of the land you buy. It sits on a lease or licence through FrontCounter BC, or under a General Permission or a Specific Permission. Ask the seller what tenure, if any, a dock has, and do not assume it transfers with the house. Delta also says foreshore and water access fall under federal, provincial or Port of Vancouver authority depending on the area.
Zoning on the east side, and what changed in 2024

The waterfront lots in Beach Grove are in zone RD2, which Delta's zoning bylaw describes as duplex and single detached residential and says is for waterfront lots in Beach Grove. Zoning is set parcel by parcel on the City's maps, so a neighbour's zone does not tell you yours, and it is the zone, not the street, that decides whether a duplex or a subdivision is even possible.

Delta's current Official Community Plan, Bylaw No. 8400, replaced the earlier plan and folded the old area plans into one Land Use Plan. Older City reports on a property can still say Single Family Residential, a designation the 2024 plan no longer uses, so a staff report that predates 2024 will not describe today's rules.

Before an offer, ask the City for four things on the exact parcel: its zone, its land use designation under the 2024 plan, the flood elevation shown on DeltaMap, and any covenant registered on the title. A title search shows the covenant, and the City shows the rest, so one request to each covers it.
Five questions to settle before you write an offer on the water
Does the title carry a covenant that sets a minimum elevation for living space, and does the house meet it? Delta says the figure is on DeltaMap.
Is the parcel inside the SD3 foreshore permit area, and if so what did the last permit for work on the lot require?
Is there a seawall, who designed it, and is it on the lot or on the dike? Work near the dike needs the Inspector of Dikes to sign off in writing.
If there is a dock or a mooring, what tenure covers it, and will it carry over to you? Ask for the lease, licence or permission in writing.
What will an insurer quote for flood and water damage on this exact address? Get the answer while subjects are still on.
Condo buildings and new homes on the east side

Two strata buildings are named in the directories we read. Royal Oaks at 1100 56 Street has 109 units (strata plan LMS515), just north of the town centre. Heron Cove at 1706 56 Street has 101 units (strata plan LMS2509) and is in Beach Grove. Those details come from a strata-building directory, not from the City, so confirm them in the strata documents.

The Southlands lands at Market Avenue are the large new-development site here. The developer, Century Group, lists 101 – 6388 Market Avenue as its address, and the City of Delta files the lands under Southlands Properties of Century Industries Ltd., file LU006390.

Delta School District (SD37) sets catchments by address, and it publishes catchment maps for the Tsawwassen area (last updated October 2017) plus an online school locator. We could not run the locator for an east-side home address, so we are not naming a catchment school. Use the locator for the exact address.

Condo buildings in Tsawwassen East
Royal Oaks — 1100 56 Street, just north of the town centre on the east side
Low-rise apartment form with elevator, underground parking, club house and guest suite according to the strata directory.
Heron Cove — 1706 56 Street (directory address 1704 56th Street), Beach Grove

Built 2005 (directory and an MLS listing agree). Amenities according to the strata directory: bike room, elevator, guest suite, in-suite laundry. Restrictions according to the strata directory: pets allowed with restrictions; rentals not allowed — again.
Windgrove (also listed as Windgrove Residence) — 1642 56 Street, Beach Grove

Small low-rise building: the building directory records built 2006 and 12 units, with elevator, in-suite laundry and storage (one directory entry adds club house and garden). Restrictions according to the strata directory: pets allowed with restrictions; rentals allowed with restrictions. A listing for a unit in the building describes a pet-friendly building with no restriction on pet size — directory and listing do not match.
Tsawwassen Mews — 5622 16 Avenue, Beach Grove
The corridor's oldest strata stock: the building directory's index records 3 levels, completed 1977, freehold strata.
Where the condos are and what to know

items.t: Beach Grove, the waterfront pocket inside the east side, is bordered by 19th Avenue, 56th Street, 12th Avenue and the banks of Boundary Bay (neighbourhood description, secondary source).

Local roads are Boundary Bay Road, 12 Avenue and 56 Street; Highway 17 is reached via 56 Street or 52 Street, then Highway 17A and Highway 99 via the George Massey Tunnel. Route 601 runs Boundary Bay trips via 12 Avenue, Boundary Bay Road, 3 Avenue and 67 Street to 1A Avenue, continuing via South Delta Exchange and Ladner Exchange to Bridgeport Station.

Where the condo stock actually concentrates: on and just off 56 Street at the Beach Grove edge — Royal Oaks at the north end by the town centre, then Heron Cove, Windgrove and Tsawwassen Mews strung along the 56 Street / 16 Avenue corridor. The Boundary Bay waterfront streets themselves are detached and duplex houses, including the RD2 zone the bylaw states is for waterfront lots in Beach Grove.

Shopping and services sit back in the centre: Thrifty Foods on the Tsawwassen Town Centre Mall site (1219 56 Street, 5499 12 Avenue, 1236 55 Street), Tsawwassen Library at 1321A 56 St and South Delta Recreation Centre at 1720 56 St.

Hazard Development Permit Area SD3 — the east side's local overlay: for the Boundary Bay Foreshore and the Southlands, OCP Bylaw No. 8400 provides that no building be located with the underside of a wooden floor system or the top of a concrete slab for habitable areas lower than 2.9 metres Geodetic Survey of Canada datum, that the minimum land surface elevation around construction be 2.3 metres GSC datum, and that no building be constructed within 7.5 metres of the natural boundary of a tidal area. Whether a given corridor building lot falls inside SD3 needs a DeltaMap check for that lot.

The 2.9 m number is the one to remember on this shore: SD3 sets the habitable floor level at 2.9 metres GSC datum with a 2.3 m minimum land elevation around construction and a 7.5 m setback from the natural boundary of a tidal area — any renovation or rebuild conversation on a foreshore lot starts there.

A seawall has its own rule here: Zoning Bylaw No. 7600, s. 6.2.3, lets a seawall encroach into the minimum front setback on Boundary Bay lots along Beach Grove Road south of 16 Avenue — and the same passage states the bylaw sets no Beach Grove flood construction level, so the FCL question goes to the permit area and the City, not the zoning text.

The dike trail is the amenity, and it is a working dike: Boundary Bay Regional Park's Dyke Trail runs on the Boundary Bay dike system the City maintains as flood protection — recreation on top of infrastructure, which is why foreshore work is permitted, not casual.

blocks.text: Townhome complexes in Tsawwassen East
The Granary (townhome portion) — Market District, at Red Barn Boulevard and Market Avenue, Southlands
Tenure: strata — the presale source publishes an estimated strata fee for the project ($0.41 per sq ft per month, developer-estimated).
Heirloom Townhomes — Southlands
A group of 33 townhouses and duplexes, recorded as sold out in a community profile of Southlands.
High Street Rowhomes — Southlands, at Southlands Drive and Boundary Bay Road

10 homes, 3 storeys, by Century Group. Tenure: FEE-SIMPLE (non-strata freehold) — the project source states expressly that the rowhomes are "non-strata, freehold" homes with no strata fees. This is the sub-area's known fee-simple townhouse-form stock: no strata corporation, no Form B, no strata fees.
Where the townhomes are and what to know

items.t: Where the townhouse stock actually sits: in two places, neither of them on the waterfront streets. The older apartment-condo corridor runs along 56 Street / 16 Avenue at the Beach Grove edge, and the townhouse stock is the new Southlands master-planned community at the south end — Market Avenue and Boundary Bay Road, around the Market District — where Century Group is building townhomes, rowhomes and bare-land strata cottages in named collections.

Strata townhomes (The Granary): the Form B is the core document: Strata Property Act s. 59 — the Form B: Information Certificate states the lot's monthly strata fees, amounts owing, approved special levies still payable, the CRF balance net of approved expenditures, and a summary of the strata's insurance, with the rules, current budget, any Rental Disclosure Statement and the most recent depreciation report attached; the strata must provide it within 7 days, maximum $35 plus up to 25 cents per page. On a presale, the developer's disclosure statement comes first (REDMA, below) and the Form B regime applies on resale.

Depreciation reports (strata collections): since July 1, 2024, strata corporations with five or more lots must obtain a depreciation report every five years, not deferrable by vote, with 30-year projections and three CRF funding models; a strata established on or after July 1, 2024 must obtain its first report within the new-strata timeline — the position a brand-new Southlands strata starts in.

Rental-restriction bylaws are void (strata collections): as of Nov 24, 2022, no BC strata may have a residential rental-restriction bylaw — any "rentals not allowed" wording in an older Southlands or corridor document is invalid for long-term rentals. Short-term rentals can still be banned or limited by bylaw. Fee-simple homes have no strata bylaw layer at all, though municipal short-term-rental rules still apply city-wide.

ALR edges (Southlands farms): Southlands sits beside working farm land. An ALR residence cannot be stratified (Agricultural Land Commission Bulletin 09, s. 6; Strata Property Act s. 239; Agricultural Land Commission Act s. 21(1)) — the legal reason farm-adjacent housing product is structured as it is. Farm-status thresholds run in three tiers — $2,500 in farm sales on 0.8–4 ha; $2,500 plus 5% of the land value over 4 ha; $10,000 under 0.8 ha — a flat "$2,500+" statement is an error.

blocks.text: Lots and land in Tsawwassen East
Southlands

items.t: Southlands Tsawwassen (Century Group) — Market Avenue / Boundary Bay Road: Southlands as a whole is a 537-acre master-planned community planned for about 950 homes, with development approval in 2013 and sales beginning in 2020; by mid-October reporting about 120 homes had closed and about 100 were under construction — community totals across ALL housing forms, never quote them as lot counts.

The land-tenure mix is the Southlands fact: housing ranges across "single-family homes, bare-land strata single-family homes, non-strata row homes, traditional townhomes and condos," with each pocket of 10–25 homes potentially under a different ownership structure — no tenure is ever assumed from the Southlands name alone; every collection below carries its own tenure line.

High Street Rowhomes — Southlands Drive and Boundary Bay Road. FEE-SIMPLE (non-strata freehold): 10 homes, 3 storeys, by Century Group; the project source states expressly the rowhomes are "non-strata, freehold" with no strata fees. As land form: fee-simple lots with a house on each — no strata corporation, no Form B.

Beachcomber Cottages — Southlands. Bare-land strata — its own form: Detached cottages (1,320–1,410 sq ft) around a shared courtyard, described by the presale source as bare-land strata homes. Plainly: a bare-land strata lot is strata tenure — the buyer owns the strata lot (essentially the building lot itself) and the cottage on it, and Form B, strata fees for common property, and registered bylaws apply to the lot. It is not a fee-simple lot and not a townhouse.

The Granary (townhome portion) — Market District, Red Barn Boulevard and Market Avenue. Strata: 19 walk-up townhomes (plus 16 garden flats, apartment-form, counted in condos) — built housing on Southlands land, cross-referenced as a land phase only; its strata fee figure in the presale source is developer-estimated and is not a land fact. Heirloom Townhomes — Southlands. A group of 33 townhouses and duplexes recorded as sold out in a community profile — the source mixes forms and states no tenure split, so no land tenure is asserted for it here. Centennial Green — Southlands.

Other Southlands cottage collections: (e.g. Harrow Estate Cottages, described as freehold homes, and the Courtyard Cottages) are detached single-family form; tenure must be read collection by collection.

Farm ground inside the plan: the community reporting describes 275 acres of publicly owned Southlands Farm plus a 50-acre community farm inside the 537-acre community — working agriculture is part of the plan, not leftover development land, and is not lot inventory.

blocks.text: Outside Southlands

items.t: Beach Grove waterfront lots — fee-simple, large-lot form: 1728 Beach Grove Road is confirmed zoned RD2 (Duplex/Single Detached Residential 2); RD2 carries a 4,000 m² minimum lot size for subdivision, a zone the bylaw states is for waterfront lots in Beach Grove. RD2/RD3 and RS1–RS3 sit at 4,000 m² in the ladder, so east-side lots — especially on the waterfront — are much larger than town-centre minimums; urban zones RS4 (610 m²) through RS7 (335 m²) also exist in the ladder and zoning is parcel by parcel.

ALR vs non-ALR split: no area-wide split is published and none is stated. Southlands sits beside working farm land and its farm acres are planned farm (above); any individual parcel's ALR status is checked on the ALC maps by PID or civic address.
Confirm City connections for a Southlands or Beach Grove parcel; for any unserviced parcel, GWELLS plus Fraser Health's onsite-sewerage position.

blocks.text: Where lots come up and what to know

items.t: Where land actually sits, in two systems: (a) the large fee-simple waterfront/detached lots of Beach Grove and the Boundary Bay shore, and (b) the Southlands master-planned lands at the south end — Market Avenue and Boundary Bay Road — where a former farm-designated parcel is being built out in named phases. The 56 Street / 16 Avenue corridor between them is built apartment-condo stock, not land.

Dyke / flood frame: the east side faces Boundary Bay behind the Boundary Bay dike; Delta is the diking authority (over 63 km of flood protection, 31 pump stations, ~538 km of drainage). Foreshore tenure: the Province owns nearly all saltwater foreshore; tenure is by lease or licence only via FrontCounter BC, and private moorage is held under General Permission or Specific Permission — a "private dock" is not land the seller owns.

Bare-land strata block (applies to Beachcomber Cottages lots and any strata Southlands phase): Form B (SPA s. 59) discloses monthly fees, amounts owed, approved levies still payable, CRF balance and insurance summary, with rules, budget and most recent depreciation report attached; provided within 7 days, max $35 + 25¢/page. Depreciation reports every 5 years for 5+ lots since July 1, 2024, non-deferrable; a strata established on/after July 1, 2024 follows the new-strata first-report timeline. CRF minimum 10% since November 1, 2023. Rental-restriction bylaws void since November 24, 2022 (long-term; short-term may still be restricted). Only 55+ age bylaws valid (SPA ss. 123.1/123.2; May 1, 2023 exemptions). Fee-simple contrast: High Street homes carry none of this — no strata, no Form B, no fees.

Presales (REDMA) — live in Southlands: a presale buyer must receive the developer's disclosure statement (REDMA s. 18) and has a 7-day rescission period from the later of signing or acknowledging it (s. 21); deposits are held in trust.

GST — land and new homes, CRA level only: CRA GI-003: most individual personal-use vacant-land sales are exempt; business-use, in-the-course-of-business and more-than-two-part subdivision sales can be taxable — developer/newly-subdivided lots generally TAXABLE. On a new Southlands HOME, GST applies with the FTHB rebate (Bill C-4, Royal Assent March 13, 2026 per CRA News No. 122; 100% to $1M, max $50,000, phasing to $1.5M, agreements Mar 20, 2025–2031) — the rebate applies to new HOUSING, not bare land itself — and the New Housing Rebate (36%, max $6,300, $350,000–$450,000) underneath it. HBP $60,000; FHSA $40,000 / $8,000 per year; CMHC 0.6%–4.5%.

The Pillars is two products at two addresses. 1700 56 Street is the townhouse component (Beach Grove townhomes); 1702 is the apartment component (condos only). A land or housing search that treats "The Pillars" as one tenure will misprice both.

blocks.text: Acreage and rural land in Tsawwassen East

What exists is (a) individual large fee-simple lots — notably RD2 waterfront lots in Beach Grove at a 4,000 m² subdivision minimum, just under an acre as a minimum, not multi-acre parcels — and (b) Southlands, a master-planned community whose land phases are built homes in named collections, not acreage parcels for sale.
Where the acreages are and what to know

items.t: It is not an official City of Delta neighbourhood name, and the City publishes no boundary for it.
Plan: Tsawwassen East is planned under the Delta Official Community Plan, Bylaw No. 8400 (2024) — the current OCP consolidated the former area plans into a single land use plan.

Recreation, library and shopping: Tsawwassen Library (Fraser Valley Regional Library), 1321A 56 St, Delta, serves the east side from the town centre, and South Delta Recreation Centre is at 1720 56 St. A City of Delta report names the Thrifty Foods grocery store on the Tsawwassen Town Centre Mall site and lists the site addresses as 1219 56 Street, 5499 12 Avenue and 1236 55 Street.

Schools and catchments: SD37 catchments are address-based. Catchments for other Tsawwassen East addresses: check the specific address in the locator. SD37 also publishes Tsawwassen Area catchment maps (updated October 2017) and directs families to the Baragar School Locator or their local school.

The waterfront is not all owned ground: The Province owns nearly all saltwater foreshore; docks and moorage sit on tenure by lease or licence via FrontCounter BC, under General Permission or Specific Permission — not on land the seller owns outright.

blocks.text: Mobile and manufactured homes in Tsawwassen East
Position, stated at the top: Tsawwassen East has no pad-rental manufactured-home park and no other rented-pad tenure.
Mobile home parks and what to know

items.t: The current OCP consolidated the former area plans into a single land use plan; Development Permit Areas live in the OCP's Appendix B. The former "Single Family Residential designation" language in a City report (LU009394) was the former plan's designation, not the current one.

Landmarks and services: Boundary Bay Regional Park and Centennial Beach, 570 Boundary Bay Rd (Metro Vancouver), with the Dyke Trail, Savannah and Raptor trails and Cammidge House; Tsawwassen Library, 1321A 56 St; South Delta Recreation Centre, 1720 56 St; the Thrifty Foods site at 1219 56 Street / 5499 12 Avenue / 1236 55 Street; Delta Hospital, 5800 Mountain View Blvd, in Ladner (Fraser Health, 24/7 emergency). BC Ferries publishes crossing times of 1 hour 35 minutes (Tsawwassen–Swartz Bay) and 2 hours (Tsawwassen–Duke Point). Transit: route 601 runs Boundary Bay trips via 12 Avenue, Boundary Bay Road, 3 Avenue and 67 Street to 1A Avenue, continuing via South Delta Exchange and Ladner Exchange to Bridgeport Station.

Schools: SD37 catchments are address-based. Ministry-confirmed names: South Park Elementary, Beach Grove Elementary (5955 17a Ave), Cliff Drive Elementary (5025 12 Ave), South Delta Secondary. Catchments for other East addresses: run the exact address. SD37 also publishes Tsawwassen Area catchment maps (updated October 2017).

Zoning / OCP / hazard frame: OCP Bylaw No. 8400 (2024), consolidated (farm land "Agriculture (A)"). 1728 Beach Grove Road is zoned RD2 (Duplex/Single Detached Residential 2), a 4,000 m² minimum lot size for subdivision, the zone the bylaw states is for waterfront lots in Beach Grove; s.6.2.3 sets a waterfront setback for lots fronting Boundary Bay along Beach Grove Road south of 16 Avenue, under which a seawall may encroach into the minimum front setback, and the bylaw states no Beach Grove flood construction level. Hazard Development Permit Area SD3 (Boundary Bay Foreshore and the Southlands) names Southlands expressly: no habitable floor lower than 2.9 m GSC datum, minimum land surface elevation around construction 2.3 m GSC datum, no building within 7.5 m of the natural boundary of a tidal area; whether a specific lot falls inside SD3 needs a DeltaMap check for that lot. Foreshore is provincial Crown land — moorage tenure by lease/licence via FrontCounter BC, never ownership. The east side sits behind the Boundary Bay dike (City system: over 63 km of flood protection, 31 pump stations, ~538 km of drainage).
The RD2 zoning PDF returning an empty response), so those facts rest on the adaptation source's verified reading, labelled as such.

faq.a: No. It is the MLS® board's name for the Boundary Bay side of Tsawwassen. The City does not publish a boundary for it, and Delta plans Tsawwassen as a whole under its 2024 Official Community Plan, Bylaw No. 8400.
faq.q: Is Tsawwassen East an official City of Delta neighbourhood?

faq.a: The City of Delta is the diking authority. Changes to a dike or the ground beside it need written approval from the Inspector of Dikes.

faq.a: Not as part of the land. The Province owns nearly all saltwater foreshore, and private moorage needs a lease or licence through FrontCounter BC or a General or Specific Permission. Federal and Port of Vancouver rules can also apply, depending on the area.
faq.q: Can I build a dock on a Boundary Bay waterfront lot?

faq.a: Delta's zoning bylaw describes zone RD2, duplex and single detached residential, as the zone for waterfront lots in Beach Grove. Zoning is set parcel by parcel, so check the City's zoning map for the exact lot.
faq.q: What zone are Beach Grove waterfront lots in?

faq.a: Route 601 runs Boundary Bay trips along 12 Avenue, Boundary Bay Road, 3 Avenue and 67 Street, then through South Delta Exchange and Ladner Exchange to Bridgeport Station.

faq.a: No — the Beach Grove condo buildings (Royal Oaks, Heron Cove, Windgrove, Tsawwassen Mews) sit on the 56 Street / 16 Avenue corridor; the Boundary Bay waterfront stock is detached and duplex housing, including RD2 lots the bylaw describes as waterfront lots in Beach Grove.
faq.q: Are any of these buildings on the water?

faq.a: Directory records: Royal Oaks — pets allowed with restrictions; Heron Cove — pets allowed with restrictions; Windgrove — pets allowed with restrictions in the directory, but a unit listing calls the building pet-friendly with no pet-size restriction.

faq.a: The hazard layer is real but graded: SD3's floor-level (2.9 m GSC datum), land-elevation (2.3 m) and 7.5 m tidal-setback rules are written for the Boundary Bay foreshore and the Southlands, and the shore sits behind the Boundary Bay dike. Whether a specific corridor lot is inside SD3 is a DeltaMap check — do it lot by lot rather than assuming either way.
faq.q: Is flood risk priced into these buildings the way it is on the waterfront?

faq.a: Off the Form B, not the listing: the certificate states the lot's monthly fees, amounts owing, approved levies still payable, the CRF balance and an insurance summary, with the budget and the latest depreciation report attached — and since July 1, 2024 that report must be refreshed every five years for stratas of five or more lots, which is what makes an older building's fee comparable at all.
faq.q: How do I compare strata fees between a 1977 building and a 2005 building?

faq.a: No. The townhouse collections are all inside Southlands, inland of the dike around the Market District; the Boundary Bay waterfront stock is detached and duplex housing, including RD2 lots the bylaw describes as waterfront lots in Beach Grove.
faq.q: Are any east-side townhouses actually on the water?

faq.a: Tenure. The Granary is strata product (the presale source publishes an estimated strata fee), so it carries strata fees, bylaws, a Form B on resale and a depreciation report. The High Street Rowhomes are expressly non-strata freehold — no strata fees and no strata documents at all. Same community name, opposite diligence packages.
faq.q: What is the difference between a Granary townhome and a High Street rowhome if both are "townhomes" in Southlands?

faq.a: A buyer comparing it to a Granary townhome is comparing two different strata forms with different common-property obligations.
faq.q: Is a Beachcomber Cottage a townhouse?

faq.a: The large ground here is individual RD2 waterfront lots in Beach Grove (4,000 m² subdivision minimum) and the Southlands build-out, whose phases sell built homes, not acreage parcels. Known named acreage developments here: 0.
faq.q: Is there an acreage subdivision in Tsawwassen East I can buy into?

faq.a: Hazard Development Permit Area SD3 sets a 2.9 m GSC datum minimum habitable floor level, a 2.3 m minimum land elevation around construction and a 7.5 m setback from the natural boundary of a tidal area for the Boundary Bay foreshore — and whether a given lot falls inside SD3 needs a DeltaMap check for that lot. The shore sits behind the Boundary Bay dike the City maintains.
faq.q: What flood rules apply to a waterfront home in Beach Grove?

faq.a: It is a detached cottage on a bare-land strata lot in Southlands: you own the strata lot and the cottage, pay strata fees, and diligence is the Form B / disclosure statement — there is no pad, no pad rent and no MHPTA tenancy.
faq.q: Is a Beachcomber Cottage a mobile home?

faq.a: Everything that matters: on a rented pad you own only the home (a chattel) and rent the pad — that is not land ownership; in a bare-land strata you own the lot itself in strata form, with Form B, fees and bylaws instead of a tenancy agreement and park rules.
faq.q: What is the difference between bare-land strata and a rented pad?

faq.a: Once a year, on 3 full months' notice, by inflation plus the park's proportional amount: 2.3% + proportional for 2026, 2.2% + proportional for 2027 (RTB, as of Nov 1, 2026). Percentages only — no dollar rent is stated as fact here.
faq.q: If I buy on a rented pad elsewhere, how much can the rent rise?

faq.a: SD3 names the Southlands and the Boundary Bay foreshore: 2.9 m GSC datum habitable floor, 2.3 m land elevation around construction, 7.5 m setback from the natural boundary of a tidal area — behind the Boundary Bay dike Delta maintains. Confirm the lot's SD3 position with the City.
faq.q: What flood rules touch a Southlands or shore home?
